children: Brian Comstock will take over as Greenbrier's President and CEO immediately following Tekorius's retirement in January 2027. Comstock brings over 45 years of railroad industry experience, including nearly three decades at Greenbrier. He currently serves as executive vice president and president of the Americas, overseeing operations in the U.S., Canada, Mexico and Brazil. His background spans commercial, leasing and manufacturing operations. The company says Comstock's broad experience across the business positions him to guide Greenbrier's next growth phase while maintaining its customer-focused operating model.
